facts.business: Dredging Corporation of India Limited provides dredging services, fleet modernization, dredger construction and repair, and supports maritime infrastructure development in India.

capacity_or_capex.item: Modernization of Dredging Corporation of India Limited under Maritime Amrit Kaal Vision
capacity_or_capex.timeline: Announced during India Maritime Week 2025 (27-31 Oct 2025)

guidance_or_targets.statement: Procurement of new dredgers and strengthening of capabilities in maintenance dredging, capital dredging, and inland waterway development

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on Note No. 29(19) regarding asset DCl Dredger XI classified as held for sale with carrying value of ₹54,65,123 as on 31.03.2026

Dependence on government contracts and maritime policy
